# Academicons arXiv icon

Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/jpswalsh/academicons@1.9.4/svg/arxiv.svg

Academicons by James Walsh: https://github.com/jpswalsh/academicons

The supplied SVG identifies its license as SIL Open Font License: https://openfontlicense.org/open-font-license-official-text/

The original SVG is retained in arxiv.svg. The site reuses its path and transform in layouts/_partials/site_icon.html, with a matching fill and stroke for greater visual weight and a padded viewBox to avoid clipping.
